text:
support_jamie: Heads up - multiple customers reporting 504s and huge tail-latency on hosted API since 09:12. p95 ~9s, p99 ~30-45s for short requests. Customer repro: sudden batch of small prompts -> 504s. Suspect continuous-batcher backlog / queue depth hit.
oncall_alex: Seen alerts. Digging into gateway metrics now. Which tenants first?
support_jamie: 3 tenants: acme-pay, snapdesk, and a newly onboarded beta account. All on default routing. No config change on their side.
eng_ben: I can see a sharp enqueue spike at 09:11:30 in ingress. Request depth hit soft-limit, we started dropping to 504 after backlog. Continuous-batcher pending queue grew ~2.6x.
ml_ops_sara: Any kvcache evictions or cache warmup spikes? Small prompts should be cached prefixes.
eng_ben: Yes - KV cache hit rate dropped from 78% -> 22% around the same time. Eviction churn + cold starts for new model shards.
support_jamie: Customer says they experienced this intermittently during a retry loop. They hit our SDK retry (2 retries) and amplified.
oncall_alex: Adaptive-shed didn't trigger early enough. Grace-window looked saturated.
eng_ben: Snapshot of relevant logs: ```[09:11:28] ingress enqueue=1880 depth_limit=2000 dequeue=450 batching_wait=0.12s [09:11:31] continuous_batcher backlog=1200 pending_batches=94 kv_hit=0.22 evict_rate=450/s```
ml_ops_sara: That backlog is huge. Looks like tiny requests preventing batching consolidation and causing lots of small batches; continuous batching policy isn't coalescing.
customer_success_maya: Pinged acme-pay with suggested workaround: reduce client concurrency and apply exponential backoff. They're asking for ETA and root cause.
eng_ben: Short-term mitigation: lower per-tenant concurrency in gateway routing for affected customers and enable temporary isolation pool. Will roll a routing rule to divert to warmup pool.
oncall_alex: I'm preparing a rollbackable runbook. Steps: 1) set tenant concurrency cap to 8 2) enable warmup pool for model v2-small 3) bump grace-window to 400ms 4) monitor queue depth.
support_jamie: Can someone post the curl repro we used? Ops needs exact payload to recreate.
ml_ops_sara: Repro (minimal): ```curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: BearerREDACT' -d '{"model":"rwd-v2-small","prompt":"x","max_tokens":8}'``` Flood with ~250 rps from a single client to reproduce the backlog.
eng_ben: Root cause hypothesis: sudden microburst + retry loops created lots of tiny in-flight requests; continuous-batcher created many small batches that filled the dequeue buffer and prevented KV warmup. KV cache evictions from thinpool thrash made prefix misses cascade.
customer_success_maya: Customer impact: timeouts -> calls to support and potential SLA hits. They're requesting a postmortem and communication.
oncall_alex: Immediate actions taken: routing cap applied to affected tenants @09:14, warmup pool enabled @09:16, metrics alert thresholds lowered. Initial tail latency reduced by ~70% after warmup.
eng_ben: Follow-ups: 1) Increase default grace-window to 300ms for hosted tier 2) Tweak continuous-batcher policy to group tiny requests for 100ms rather than 25ms under high load 3) Add kvcache soft-reserve to protect hot prefixes 4) Publish customer-facing notes.
ml_ops_sara: Also add a test in chaos lab: simulated microburst + SDK retry amplification to ensure adaptive-shed triggers earlier.
support_jamie: I'll draft customer comms and share repro commands. Maya - can you coordinate?
customer_success_maya: On it. Will propose an incident update by EOD and offer temporary credits.
oncall_alex: Logging runbook action items in pager duty ticket PD-4892. I'll keep the thread updated. :white_check_mark:
deploy_bot: Deploy completed: routing-rule-add (id: rr-8862) at 09:16:22 by eng_ben - rollback available.
support_jamie: Thanks all. I'll close after postmortem posted and SLA impact confirmed. :thumbsup:
